description: Security policies are not reviewed at least annually.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 12.1 - A comprehensive information security policy that governs and provides direction for protection of the entity's information assets is known and current
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of annual policy review documentation, including review dates, participants, changes made, and approval signatures. Verify that all security policies and procedures are reviewed annually and updated to reflect environmental or business changes. Check for policy version control and distribution tracking.
